study_note: Single-seed exploratory TD-MPC2 Humanoid Walk state checkpoint bank through 1.5M agent decisions. Default TD-MPC2 learning and MPPI training-action settings are retained, while separate online evaluation episodes are disabled so frozen policy-prior, MPPI, and inner-SAC controllers can later be compared once with a common evaluation protocol. Because the compatibility port's online evaluations consume the shared environment and controller RNG streams, this no-evaluation run is not expected to reproduce the exact seeded trajectory of the evaluation-enabled benchmark. The configured six MPPI iterations become eight at runtime through TD-MPC2's action_dim >= 20 heuristic. Sixty portable model snapshots are retained every 25k decisions with adjacent provenance metadata; they support frozen evaluation and weight transfer, not exact training resume.
